subject: Demo scheduling for ForgeRetail — vendor intake / short walkthrough option
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@forgeretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, Apr 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Demo request: ForgeRetail evaluation

Hi Karthik,

We're starting an evaluation of inference providers for a personalization pilot at ForgeRetail and would like to schedule a demo next week to see Redwood's runtime and cost controls. Our team is aiming for the week of May 3 — ideally Wed or Thu morning PT. Can you share availability?

Also FWIW, procurement will run an intake for any vendor we demo that has access to customer data; I can loop them in if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Product Lead, Personalization
ForgeRetail
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena@forgeretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, Apr 25, 2027 at 10:05 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: ForgeRetail evaluation

Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the context. We'd love to show a tailored walkthrough.

I can do a 60-minute session on Tue May 4 at 10:00 AM PT or Thu May 6 at 9:00 AM PT. Laura (solutions engineer) will join to cover integration patterns.

Quick note on procurement/security: if ForgeRetail requires vendor onboarding (intake form) and an NDA before product-level access, that can block a full technical demo where we share customer-config examples. If you can share the intake form or requirements now, we'll start the paperwork immediately.

Proposed next steps:
- Let us know which slot you'd prefer (May 4 or May 6)
- Share any vendor intake / security questionnaire and NDA recipient for DocuSign

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@forgeretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Elena Morris <elena@forgeretail.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 26, 2027 at 2:20 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: ForgeRetail evaluation

Hi Elena / Karthik — looping procurement/security.

A couple of gating items before we allow deeper technical demos with customer samples:
1) Completed vendor intake form (attached)
2) Signed mutual NDA (we need DocuSign link)
3) SOC 2 Type II attestation and brief questionnaire answers

If those are completed we can schedule a full 60–90 minute technical demo with our security folks present. Otherwise, we can allow a 30-minute high-level walkthrough that avoids customer data and configuration details.

Attaching: Vendor_Intake_Form_FR_v3.pdf (fillable PDF)

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Procurement Manager, ForgeRetail
Attachments: Vendor_Intake_Form_FR_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@forgeretail.com>, Elena Morris <elena@forgeretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Apr 27, 2027 at 8:37 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: ForgeRetail evaluation

Samir — thanks for the checklist and the intake form. We're happy to complete this. A few notes from our side: 

- We'll return the filled vendor intake and the NDA signature as soon as possible. Can you confirm whether you prefer a DocuSign route or an emailed PDF with signature?
- We're preparing our SOC 2 summary and will attach the attestation; expect that by EOD Apr 29.
- Heads-up: our Principal Solutions Engineer (R&D) is traveling May 2–6 and won't be available for a deep technical session in that window. We can still do a brief 30-minute overview (no customer data) during that period if that helps unblock procurement review.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Intake_Responses_DRAFT.pdf (will be finalized after internal review)
From: Elena Morris <elena@forgeretail.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 11:02 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: ForgeRetail evaluation

Thanks Laura — that timeline works. A couple of follow-ups: 
- We prefer DocuSign for the NDA; can you send the envelope to legal@forgeretail.com and to me?
- If you can do a 30-minute walkthrough on Thu May 6 at 9:00 AM PT that would help the business team see the UX and decide whether to push the intake forward. That short session would not satisfy security for a full deep dive, but it's enough to evaluate fit.

Would you be able to provide the DocuSign link and, if possible, an editable intake form (Word) so we can make notes in-line?

Best,
Elena
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena@forgeretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 3:04 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: ForgeRetail evaluation

Elena / Samir — thanks, we'll proceed on two tracks to keep momentum: 

1) Short unblock walkthrough (30 min)
   - Confirmed: Thu May 6, 2027 at 9:00 AM PT (30 minutes) — hosted by Laura (solutions engineer) and myself. This will be a product overview only (no customer data, no full config).

2) Full technical demo (60–90 min)
   - We'll target the week of May 10 for the deeper session once intake + NDA + SOC 2 attestation are in place. Please confirm preferred windows that week and we'll lock a slot.

Actions I will take by EOD Apr 30:
- Send DocuSign envelope for the mutual NDA to legal@forgeretail.com and elena@forgeretail.com (link below)
- Upload a Word version of the intake form for ease of editing
- Attach a draft of our intake responses so you can review and flag anything missing (see attachments)

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/templates/ABC123/send
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890

Thanks all — looking forward to the quick walkthrough and then the deeper session once procurement signs off.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
